title: createField request
description: Create a field (attribute) definition. snake_case body. custom_field_name and custom_field_type required; custom_field_format must be a FieldFormat value; hide is 'Y'/'N'. KNOWN ISSUE: the current build's type validation is inverted — it rejects the intended values 'SINGLE'/'MULTIPLE' with E1004 and accepts other strings. Until fixed, create fields in the admin UI rather than via this endpoint. Errors: E1006 (missing), E1004 (format not in vocabulary), E1001 (unknown group_id).

group_id.description: Optional group to place the field in.
